summary: Verified the NOW-WORKING SAP supplier sync end-to-end with real data (2984 suppliers), the new pagination on Supplier Master List, and confirmed no regressions on previously-tested CRUD/assignment flows or other nav tabs. All flows passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the Radix Select supplier dropdown in the assignment dialog still intermittently triggers CRA dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' full-screen red overlay. Underlying functionality (assignment save) completed successfully underneath it - purely cosmetic dev-mode overlay issue, dismissible via Escape, not present in production build.

action_items: No functional fixes required. Optional/low-priority (carried over from iteration_43): consider suppressing CRA dev overlay for benign ResizeObserver warnings to avoid confusing screen takeovers during testing/dev; not an issue in prod build.
critical_code_review_comments: Pagination implemented client-side (filters full 2984-row array in memory, then slices) - acceptable for ~3k rows but note the assignment-dialog's supplier <Select> still renders all ~2984 <SelectItem> options unvirtualized; this worked fine and selection was fast/responsive in testing, but could be a future scale concern if supplier count grows much further.
Good async job+polling pattern for the 60-90s SAP sync: button correctly shows 'Syncing...' the entire time (verified ~85s), no premature error, no freeze, success toast expected on completion.
html.unescape() fix confirmed working - verified 'A & D TECHNOLOGY' renders with a real ampersand, not '&', directly in the live table.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for this app/feature
seed_data_creation: Created and fully cleaned up: 1 local test supplier (TEST_QA_Supplier) and 1 part-supplier assignment against product TEST-PART-QA (assigned to real SAP supplier '165 DEGREE'). Both deleted after verification; confirmed final supplier count returned to 2984 and assignment list for TEST-PART-QA returned to empty. No real SAP-synced data was touched/deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suppliers page fully re-verified with real SAP data (2984 suppliers): (1) Master list loads with correct SAP badges and correctly-unescaped names (e.g. 'A & D TECHNOLOGY', not '&'). (2) Pagination bar shows 'Showing 1-50 of 2984' / 'Page 1 of 60', Previous disabled on page 1, Next advances to page 2 with different rows ('AAROHAN ENGINEERS'), Previous returns correctly to page 1. (3) Search ('steel') correctly filters (77 matches, 2 pages) AND resets pagination to page 1 on every keystroke. (4) Add Supplier -> new row shows 'Local' badge (not SAP), confirmed via search isolating the single new row. (5) Sync from SAP button showed 'Syncing...' continuously for ~85 seconds with button disabled, completed with no error banner, count stayed correct (2984, since these already existed - re-sync was mostly updates). (6) Assignment flow: loaded product TEST-PART-QA, opened Assign Supplier dialog, dropdown listed all real suppliers ('165 DEGREE' first alphabetically), selected it, filled quota/lead-time/price, saved -> appeared correctly in assignments table with real supplier name and all values. (7) Deleted the test assignment and test local supplier - confirmed via search + pagination bar that master list count returned to exactly 2984 (no real data lost). (8) Regression smoke-check: BOM Explorer, Purchasing Plan, Production Plan, Inventory, Admin all load without crash or console errors. Only cosmetic dev-mode ResizeObserver overlay noted again (same as iteration_43, non-blocking, non-prod).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional bugs found. The recurring dev-overlay cosmetic issue is a known CRA dev-server + Radix UI Select ResizeObserver interaction quirk, unrelated to app/business logic, and does not appear in production builds.
